posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
While I can appreciate and support inclusiveness, I must say I am disheartened by the lumping together of so many individual items into one pronoun.

Celebrating inclusiveness should not also cheapen the distinction that make things different.

Are we not all one?

Is one, not also all us?
